([[Flint, Michigan]]) | college = * [[Eastern Michigan Eagles men's basketball|Eastern Michigan]] (2022–2023) * [[Bowling Green Falcons men's basketball|Bowling Green]] (2023–2024) | draft_year = 2024 | career_start = 2024 | career_end = | years1 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2024–2025]] | team1 = [[Delaware Blue Coats]] | years2 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2025]]–present | team2 = [[Birmingham Squadron]] | highlights = }} '''Joseph Raji "JZ" Zaher''' (born July 1, 2004) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Birmingham Squadron]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Eastern Michigan Eagles men's basketball|Eastern Michigan Eagles]] and the [[Bowling Green Falcons men's basketball|Bowling Green Falcons]]. ==Early life and high school career== Zaher was born in [[Fenton, Michigan]].{{cite news |title=JZ Zaher Biography |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/player/bio/_/id/5108766/jz-zaher |access-date= |work=[[ESPN]] |date=}} He attended [[Powers Catholic High School]] in [[Flint, Michigan]].{{cite news |title=JZ Zaher Player Profile |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/JZ-Zaher/Summary/199887 |access-date= |work=Real GM|date=July 24, 2017}} During his senior campaign at Flint Powers Catholic, Zaher averaged 4.4 points, 1.6 rebounds, and 0.4 assists per game.{{cite news |date= |title=JZ Zaher - Mens Basketball - Bowling State University Athletics |url=https://bgsufalcons.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/jz-zaher/9872 |access-date= |work=BGSU Falcons}} ==College career== Zaher is a sophomore guard for the Bowling Green State University (BGSU) Falcons. He wears jersey number 17. Prior to joining BGSU, Zaher played for Eastern Michigan. During the 2023–24 season, Zaher appeared in seven games for the Falcons. He recorded a season-high of four points against Ohio Dominican on December 10, including the first three-pointer of his college career. He averaged 4.4 minutes, 0.7 points, and 1.0 rebounds per game.{{cite news |title=BGSU men’s basketball’s JZ Zaher declares for the 2024 NBA draft |url=https://bgfalconmedia.com/157091/sports/bgsu-mens-basketballs-jz-zaher-declares-for-the-2024-nba-draft/|access-date=April 3, 2024 |work=BG Falcon Media|date=April 3, 2024}} In a significant move, Zaher declared for the [[2024 NBA draft]]. This made him the first Falcon to declare for the 2024 draft. ==Professional career== After going undrafted in the [[2024 NBA draft]], Zaher joined the [[Delaware Blue Coats]] of the [[NBA G League]] on October 28, 2024.{{cite tweet|author=Delaware Blue Coats|title=ready for camp.🫡 #GetYourCoatsOn|number=1850954040386986467|user=blue_coats|date=October 28, 2024|access-date=November 3, 2024}}{{cite web|title=2024-2025 Delaware Blue Coats Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Delaware-Blue-Coats/57/Transaction_History/2025|website=RealGM.com|access-date=November 11, 2024}} On October 25, 2025, Zaher, the 31st pick in the G League draft, and [[Darryl Morsell]] were traded to the [[Birmingham Squadron]] in exchange for Chris Mantis and the 20th pick in the G League draft.{{Cite web|title=Birmingham Squadron selects Tray Jackson, acquires Zaher and Morsell in G League draft|url=https://abc3340.com/sports/more-sports/birmingham-squadron-selects-tray-jackson-acquires-zaher-and-morsell-in-g-league-draft|access-date=October 29, 2025|website=abc3340.com|language=en}}
